data.body: Provenance of the 32k compaction refusal: c848df3 "Scale every compaction budget with the effective window" added the percentage budgets AND MINIMUM_COMPACT_CONTEXT_WINDOW=64_000 together, deliberately, with a test asserting a 32k window compacts nothing. So it is not legacy debt: the budgets are proportional, but this one guard is not, and its justification ("the derived check fails below ~64k") is false for a small fixed context - its own test passes the headroom check at 32,768 with fixed 3,000. The second gate (headroom >= W/4) is proportional and genuinely refuses the operator's 32k run: fixed ~12.3k plus the 32%-of-window replacement exceeds a quarter of the window. Not a regression and not the old absolute era (maxTokens was inert above 51,200 and now deserialises into a legacy sink). Levers: drop the constant; make retention/user/summary adaptive below ~64k; or shrink the fixed context (~37 tool schemas + 13 KB prompt).
